therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer receiving FOLFOX6 chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: number of patients with neuropathy grade 2 or higher according to Oxaliplatin Specific Sanofi Scale

results.dose_information: 2 µmol/kg, 5 µmol/kg, or 10 µmol/kg administered intravenously over 5 minutes, 10 minutes prior to FOLFOX6, every 2 weeks for up to 8 cycles
